rows.note: Use 都 as the all-purpose casual choice when something happens despite a contrary condition or reluctance.

example.english: Even if it rains, I'll go anyway.
example.jyutping: zau6 syun3 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dou1 heoi3

rows.note: Use 照 when someone proceeds with an action regardless, especially before a verb.

example.english: You don't like it, but I'll do it anyway.
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 zung1 ji3 ngo5 ziu3 zou6

rows.note: Use 橫𠶧 when anyway means ‘in any case’ as a sentence linker supporting or qualifying what was just said.

example.english: Anyway, we still have to do it today.
example.jyutping: waang4 dim6 gam1 jat6 dou1 hai6 jiu3 zou6 gaa3 laa3

rows.note: Use 講開又講 when anyway signals a shift to a related new subject.

example.english: Anyway, do you know how to cook?
example.traditional: 講開又講，你識唔識煮飯？
example.jyutping: gong2 hoi1 jau6 gong2 nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 zyu2 faan6
